quotes.name: Cristina Booker
quotes.quote: To be honest, I'm not sure what you're referring to with my 'dead even performance.' I'm just going about my daily life as an immigration attorney here in Downtown Oakland. I haven't noticed anything out of the ordinary happening to me recently.
